title: Occupancy Condition 5.
officialText:
Each sleeping area in Occupancy Condition 5 shall be separated from adjacent sleeping areas, corridors
and common spaces by a smoke-tight partition. Additionally, common spaces shall be separated from the corridor by a smoke-tight
partition.
